consequence.statement: GlobalContextEntry API calls that do not set retryLimit now use the default of 3, so Kyverno retries a failed call instead of failing on the first attempt.
consequence.remediation: To control how many times a failed API call is retried, set spec.apiCall.retryLimit explicitly (minimum 1).

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional retryLimit field to GlobalContextEntry apiCall (spec.apiCall.retryLimit, integer, minimum 1, default 3), so failed API calls are now retried by default.
